$comment: Operator master taxonomy (10 families). Catalog only — not 1,000 live evaluate() edges. Live Quant evaluateAll() remains five CORE unless a per-id env flag in quantExperimentalStrategies.json is the string true. Do not enable those flags to see if it works. Walk-forward OOS for checked combos failed; experimental stays UNVALIDATED.
note: A named archetype is not a validated edge. CORE/EXPERIMENTAL mappings are partial implementations of the named mechanic. NOT_SUPPORTED means Argus has no honest evaluate() for that mechanic (missing data, missing model, or not on the Quant path).

families.name: Trend-Following & Momentum
families.premise: Prices can show intermediate-horizon autocorrelation from underreaction, allocator flows, and herding. Not proven in this environment.

archetypes.name: Dual Moving Average Crossover
archetypes.implementationNote: Current SMA50/SMA200 + EMA9/EMA20 stack and ADX. Not a same-bar 10/30 or 50/200 cross event.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Fast/slow MA alignment can mark a regime shift from chop to directional markup/markdown.
archetypes.invalidation: Whipsaw in range-bound markets; stack lag at inflections.

archetypes.name: Triple Moving Average Ribbon
archetypes.implementationNote: Same MA_CROSSOVER stack; not a dedicated 20/50/200 ribbon detector.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Multi-period MA agreement filters some false dual-MA crosses.
archetypes.invalidation: Late entry; high lag at turning points.

archetypes.name: Donchian Channel Breakout (Turtle)
archetypes.implementationNote: Prior N-bar high/low excluding current bar (donchianPriorLookback). No Turtle 10-bar exit unit.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: N-period channel breaks can capture fat-tail trend runs.
archetypes.invalidation: Low win rate; needs positive skew; UNVALIDATED here.

archetypes.name: Time-Series (Absolute) Momentum
archetypes.implementationNote: Regime + structure trend module. Not 12-1 month excess return vs rf, not cash overlay.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Persistent directional regimes can continue over intermediate horizons.
archetypes.invalidation: V-reversals; CORE is UNTESTED on NEXT_BAR OOS in this environment.

archetypes.name: Cross-Sectional Relative Strength (12-1)
archetypes.implementationNote: Symbol vs SPY plus sector regime. Not a universe decile long/short skipping t-1.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Leaders can continue to attract institutional flow versus the benchmark.
archetypes.invalidation: Momentum crashes; not a market-neutral factor book.

archetypes.name: MACD / Signal Line / Zero-Cross
archetypes.implementationNote: MACD histogram + RSI midline + ROC family. Divergence remains a feature (isTradeSignal false), not a standalone trade.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Momentum acceleration can confirm a directional regime.

archetypes.name: Parabolic SAR Trend Acceleration
archetypes.reason: No Parabolic SAR series on StrategyContext. Live stops use tradingSafety.stopLossAssumptionPct, not SAR.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Accelerating trailing stop-and-reverse can lock trend velocity.

archetypes.name: Ichimoku Kinko Hyo (Kumo Breakout)
archetypes.reason: No Tenkan/Kijun/Span A/B cloud features. Do not fake Ichimoku from SMA.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Cloud equilibrium can filter trend vs balance.
archetypes.invalidation: Parameter sensitivity; missing cloud data here.

archetypes.name: Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average (KAMA)
archetypes.reason: No Efficiency Ratio or KAMA series. MA_CROSSOVER uses SMA/EMA only.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Adaptive smoothing can slow in chop and speed in trends.
archetypes.invalidation: Can lag static MAs in parabolic runs.

archetypes.name: SuperTrend / ATR Trailing Stop Following
archetypes.reason: No SuperTrend bands. Live RiskEngine sizing is not ATR-based.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: k×ATR offset from median can trail volatility expansion.

families.name: Mean Reversion & Counter-Trend
families.premise: Temporary liquidity shocks can pull price from a statistical or session mean, then revert. Left-tail risk if the mean walks away.

archetypes.name: Bollinger Band Mean Reversion
archetypes.implementationNote: Keltner extremes + RSI + StochRSI in SIDEWAYS_RANGE. VolatilityFeatures expose BB width%, not 2σ/3σ band levels — not a Gaussian BB fade.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Extensions from a volatility envelope can revert inside a range.
archetypes.invalidation: Riding the bands in breakout regimes; CORE UNTESTED OOS.

archetypes.name: 2-Period RSI (Connors RSI)
archetypes.reason: No RSI(2)<5/10 with 200-SMA filter as specified. OSCILLATOR_MOMENTUM uses RSI midline, not Connors.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Short-term seller exhaustion in a structural uptrend.

archetypes.name: Keltner / Bollinger Squeeze Reversion
archetypes.implementationNote: Squeeze then Keltner expansion breakout (continuation), not a fade of a failed expansion.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Vol contraction/expansion cycles can precede directional range expansion.
archetypes.invalidation: This module is breakout-oriented; a true squeeze-fade is not coded.

archetypes.name: Standardized Z-Score Price Reversion
archetypes.implementationNote: UNVALIDATED. Rolling close z-score from statistics.ts plus RSI in SIDEWAYS_RANGE. |z| and lookback from quantExperimentalStrategies.json. Not pairs/cointegration. Live evaluateAll only if QUANT_STATISTICAL_REVERSION_ENABLED=true.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Stationary normalized close can revert toward zero z.
archetypes.invalidation: Non-stationary fat-tail regime shifts; z-score keeps extending.

archetypes.name: Overnight Gap Fill
archetypes.reason: GAP_CONTINUATION is gap-and-go with RVOL, not a fade to prior close. No earnings calendar to exclude gap-and-go.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: RTH liquidity can fill overnight overreaction.

archetypes.name: Stochastic Oscillator %K/%D Hook
archetypes.implementationNote: Stochastic RSI extremes, not classic %K/%D hook from 20/80.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Short-cycle oscillator exhaustion in a range.

archetypes.name: VWAP Mean Reversion
archetypes.implementationNote: Session VWAP distance in a low-ADX range. Not ±2 VWAP σ bands (no VWAP stdev series).
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Intraday volume-weighted mean can attract mean-reverting flow.
archetypes.invalidation: Trend days; VWAP unavailable on some daily-only contexts.

archetypes.name: DeMark Sequential Exhaustion (TD Sequential)
archetypes.reason: No TD 9/13 countdown features.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Fixed countdown of closes vs close-4 can time exhaustion.
archetypes.invalidation: Weak on high-beta breakouts; not implemented.

families.name: Breakout & Volatility Expansion
families.premise: Compression can precede directional expansion when ranges and stops are breached. High fake-out rate.

archetypes.name: Opening Range Breakout (ORB)
archetypes.implementationNote: Opening range is unavailable on daily bars (honest fail, not a fabricated OR).
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: First RTH range can express session directional intent.

archetypes.name: Narrow Range 7 / Inside Bar Breakout
archetypes.reason: No NR7 / inside-bar detector on PriceActionFeatures.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Narrowest recent range can precede expansion.

archetypes.name: Prior Period High/Low Breakout
archetypes.implementationNote: Previous-day high/low with RVOL. Weekly is a 5-day approximation on daily bars.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Breaks of widely watched prior highs can cascade stops.

archetypes.name: Bollinger Band Width Expansion
archetypes.implementationNote: Band-width squeeze then Keltner expansion. Direction from the expansion break, not a separate BBW oscillator.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Multi-session low bandwidth then expansion can start markup.

archetypes.name: ATR Expansion Breakout
archetypes.implementationNote: Momentum breakout + RVOL/structure. Not today's range > 2.0×ATR(14) as a named condition.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Range expansion with volume can mark institutional aggression.
archetypes.invalidation: Climax bars at the end of a move.

archetypes.name: Floor Trader Pivot Point Breakouts
archetypes.implementationNote: Nearest S/R bounce with reversal candle. Not R1/S1/R2/S2 pivot formula breakouts with volume delta.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Widely watched reference levels can attract algorithmic flow.
archetypes.invalidation: Pivots as reversal magnets; no L2 delta.

families.name: Market Structure, Price Action & Order Flow
families.premise: Auction and institutional liquidity hypotheses. Argus has daily/bar SMC pattern classification, not L2/DOM/footprint.

archetypes.name: Fair Value Gap / Imbalance Fill
archetypes.reason: SMC module classifies sweep/liquidity patterns; FVG fill-as-entry is not a standalone evaluate() with 3-candle displacement gaps as the trade.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Markets may re-auction inefficient gaps.
archetypes.invalidation: Displacement through the gap without pause.

archetypes.name: Liquidity Sweep / Stop Hunt Reversal
archetypes.implementationNote: UNVALIDATED. Sweep is a pattern (isTradeSignal false on the detector). Live evaluateAll excludes unless QUANT_SMC_STRATEGY_ENABLED=true. Backtest long-only.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Wick through equal highs/lows then close back can mark stop absorption.
archetypes.invalidation: Sweep that becomes a genuine breakout.

archetypes.name: Order Block Retest
archetypes.reason: No dedicated last-opposing-candle OB mitigation evaluate(). Do not treat SMC sweep as OB.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Unfilled institutional limit origin may be revisited.

archetypes.name: Volume Profile Point of Control Bounce
archetypes.reason: QuantitativeFeatureEngine reports volume profile / POC as NOT_SUPPORTED. VOLUME_CONFIRMATION is RVOL+CMF/MFI, not VPOC.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Highest-volume node can act as accepted fair value.

archetypes.name: Value Area High/Low Rejection
archetypes.reason: No Market Profile VAH/VAL / 80% rule features.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Failure to accept outside value can rotate to the opposite bound.

archetypes.name: Cumulative Volume Delta Absorption Divergence
archetypes.reason: No footprint/CVD feed. Alpaca IEX is top-of-book, not L2.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Passive limits absorbing aggressive sells can precede a squeeze.

archetypes.name: Footprint / Order Book Imbalance Stacking
archetypes.reason: No L2/L3 DOM. UI must not show a fake ladder.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Stacked bid/ask imbalance can mark aggressive initiation.
archetypes.invalidation: Latency and adverse selection; no book here.

families.name: Statistical Arbitrage & Relative Value
families.premise: Cointegration and factor-neutral books need universe, hedge ratios, and execution. Argus equity Quant is single-name directional, not a pairs engine.

archetypes.name: Cointegrated Pairs Trading (Engle-Granger)
archetypes.reason: No Engle-Granger/Johansen spread, no β hedge, no pairs execution. Feature engine marks pairs NOT_SUPPORTED.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Stationary spread mean reversion if cointegration holds.

archetypes.name: Fama-French Multi-Factor Long/Short
archetypes.reason: No P/B, ROE, size decile ranking universe. Not a factor-neutral book.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Factor premia with market-beta neutralization.
archetypes.invalidation: Factor crowding and multi-year factor drawdowns.

archetypes.name: Statistical Lead-Lag Arbitrage
archetypes.reason: No cross-listed/ADR latency book; not an HFT venue.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Information diffusion lag across venues.
archetypes.invalidation: Colocation and HFT close the gap.

archetypes.name: Index Arbitrage (Cash vs Futures)
archetypes.reason: No index-future basis vs fair carry; no basket execution.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Creation/redemption bounds the basis.

archetypes.name: Kalman Filter Dynamic Beta Pairs
archetypes.reason: No state-space β_t estimator.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Adaptive hedge ratio reduces window bias.

families.name: Market Making, High-Frequency & Microstructure
families.premise: Requires colocated quotes, inventory, and rebate economics. Argus OMS is retail-broker market orders, not a maker engine.

archetypes.name: Avellaneda-Stoikov Inventory Market Making
archetypes.reason: No two-sided quoting, no inventory-skew quotes, no maker OMS.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Earn spread while skewing quotes with inventory q.

archetypes.name: VPIN Toxicity Sizing
archetypes.reason: No volume-synchronized toxicity estimator.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Widen or pull when flow is toxic.

archetypes.name: Queue Position / Maker Rebate Harvesting
archetypes.reason: Alpaca qty market orders; no queue-priority limit path.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Maker rebates with short holding.
archetypes.invalidation: Filled only when the book is about to run.

archetypes.name: Cross-Exchange Latency Arbitrage
archetypes.reason: No SIP vs direct feed, no colocated router.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Sub-ms discrepancies across venues.

families.name: Options, Volatility Surface & Derivatives
families.premise: Needs listed options, IV/RV, greeks, and an options broker. Argus does not invent an options book.

archetypes.name: Delta-Neutral Straddle / Strangle Selling
archetypes.reason: No options chain, IV, or delta hedge. Feature engine options = NOT_SUPPORTED.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: IV often exceeds RV (volatility risk premium).
archetypes.invalidation: Gap/gamma blowups; undefined loss on shorts.

archetypes.name: Gamma Scalping
archetypes.reason: No long-option + underlying delta hedge loop.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: RV > IV can pay gamma vs theta.

archetypes.name: Iron Condor / Iron Butterfly
archetypes.reason: No defined-risk option spreads.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Range-bound premium decay.

archetypes.name: Earnings Volatility Crush
archetypes.reason: No earnings calendar and no options IV crush trade.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Post-event IV collapse.

archetypes.name: Volatility Term Structure Arbitrage
archetypes.reason: No VIX futures curve book.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Roll yield in contango/backwardation.

archetypes.name: Risk Reversal Skew Arbitrage
archetypes.reason: No vol smile/skew surface.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Skew mean-reversion vs hedging demand.

families.name: Event-Driven, News & Catalyst
families.premise: NewsAgent and MacroAgent exist on the live idea path; they are not Quant evaluate() modules and do not bypass RiskEngine. No PEAD/SUE or merger book.

archetypes.name: Post-Earnings Announcement Drift (PEAD)
archetypes.reason: No SUE ranking or earnings-day systematic book. News sentiment is not PEAD.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Slow institutional reweighting after earnings surprises.

archetypes.name: Merger Arbitrage (Cash / Stock)
archetypes.reason: No deal-spread book or acquirer short overlay.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Deal spread compensates completion risk.

archetypes.name: Index Rebalance Pre-Positioning
archetypes.reason: No S&P/MSCI reconstitution calendar.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Passive funds must trade the close.

archetypes.name: Ultra-Fast NLP Headline Sentiment
archetypes.reason: NewsAgent is not a sub-second FinBERT OMS. Quant taxonomy must not claim NewsAgent as this archetype. Last scored NewsAgent accuracy was not a live edge.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Fast parsing of wires before slower capital reacts.
archetypes.invalidation: Misclassification; retractions; 44.6% scored accuracy is not an edge.

archetypes.name: Central Bank Rate Decision Straddle
archetypes.reason: No options straddle and no event-vol booking of FOMC.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Surprise rate moves can exceed implied vol.

families.name: Macroeconomic, Cross-Asset & Global Cycle
families.premise: MacroAgent can attach qualitative macro context. It does not trade FX carry, curve flies, or commodity rolls. Canadian automated equity routing remains NOT AVAILABLE.

archetypes.name: G10 FX Carry Trade
archetypes.reason: No FX carry book; Coinbase is crypto spot only; no CAD automated equity routing via this taxonomy.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: UIP often fails in stable regimes.

archetypes.name: Yield Curve Steepener / Flattener
archetypes.reason: No Treasury futures curve book.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Policy vs long-term growth/inflation repricing.

archetypes.name: Commodity Roll Yield (Backwardation)
archetypes.reason: No commodity futures curve / roll engine.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Positive roll in backwardation.

archetypes.name: Global Sector Rotation (Risk-On/Off)
archetypes.implementationNote: Symbol vs SPY + sector ETF regime. Not PMI/yield-curve systematic rotation across XLU/XLP/XLK.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Sector leadership can persist with benchmark relative strength.

families.name: Machine Learning, Deep Learning & Quantitative AI
families.premise: LLMs on the live path interpret; they do not invent prices/EV or bypass RiskEngine. Kronos/Chronos is a separate forecast agent, not a Quant strategy id.

archetypes.name: Gradient Boosted Trees (XGBoost / CatBoost)
archetypes.reason: No trained GBDT directional classifier in Quant evaluate(). Do not treat indicator stacks as XGBoost.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Non-linear feature interactions can beat linear models.

archetypes.name: Foundation Time-Series Forecasting (Chronos)
archetypes.reason: KronosForecastAgent is not a StrategyEngine id. Health-down is an honest warning, not a fabricated path. Not in CORE/EXPERIMENTAL lists.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Pretrained temporal models can emit probabilistic paths.

archetypes.name: Reinforcement Learning Dynamic Allocator (PPO/SAC)
archetypes.reason: No PPO/SAC policy. PositionSizing is FIXED_DOLLAR or PERCENT_OF_EQUITY; Kelly is Quant-side EV gate only, not RL.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Learned sizing/rebalance policy vs a reward (e.g. Sharpe).

archetypes.name: LLM Multi-Agent Adversarial Debate Consensus
archetypes.reason: ChiefTrader + optional Bull/Bear notes are the live debate path, not a Quant evaluate() archetype. Mapping it here as CORE would falsely imply QuantEngine emits this id. LLM numeric invention is rejected (parseResearchNote).
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Qualitative synthesis of unstructured catalysts under risk bounds.
archetypes.invalidation: Hallucination; uncalibrated confidence. Not a Quant module.

archetypes.name: Graph Neural Network Spillover Arbitrage
archetypes.reason: No supply-chain GNN.
archetypes.edgeHypothesis: Customer/supplier graphs can delay-price earnings contagion.
